Description: Responsible for investor credential registration, unique user identification, authentication, session creation and termination, and the access-control context used to associate restricted operations with the authenticated investor.

Responsible for individual investor accounts and profiles, including personal and contact data, registered card information, opening and current cash balances, account creation and access statistics, account consultation, and profile updates while coordinating credential changes with the authentication domain.

Responsible for asset quotations and consolidated market information, including multi-asset queries, company and price data, traded volume, market performance indicators, gainers and losers, invalid-symbol handling, and market-data updates produced by completed trades.

Responsible for buy and sell orders throughout their lifecycle, including unique order creation, fixed transaction fees, immediate or deferred processing, status transitions, duplicate-completion prevention, validation of sell availability, trade settlement, submission confirmation, order history, and alerts for completed orders not yet presented to the investor.
Communicate With: Authentication Service;Investor Account Service;Market Data Service;Portfolio Service

Description: Responsible for maintaining investor positions created and removed by completed trades, exposing portfolio contents, calculating current position values and gains or losses from market prices, handling empty portfolios, and providing consolidated invested value, market value, and financial-position indicators.

Responsible for operational simulation configuration and environment administration, including order-processing mode, simulated user and asset limits, market-summary refresh interval, completed-order alert enablement, preparation or reconstruction of simulation data, controlled operational reset, and aggregated execution statistics for users, assets, orders, cancellations, and positions.
Communicate With: Authentication Service;Investor Account Service;Market Data Service;Trading Service;Portfolio Service
